title: M8b camp shop workbench roster and T13b — isolated packet
purpose: Implement the exact camp economy and menu interface while consuming the Call 2 progression API.

in: Use existing CampInit, CampProximity, DeployToBattle, menu IDs 3 Shop/4 Workbench/5 Roster/6 Deploy and keyboard Z/X/V. Camp station open within 96 and close beyond 128; keep station menu order/selection and cursor behavior.

Shop in exact order: M1 Garand 200, Thompson 250, BAR 400, Bazooka 500, M1911 60, Clip×50 30, Rockets×2 60, Frag×2 40, Satchel×1 80, Bandage×2 30. Apply FL_Stats.Price with Quartermaster modifier, refuse owned gun/hands full/over CapKg/insufficient funds and give exact messages.
